Aircraft Position and Speed Variables

The following simulation variables relate to aircraft position and speed.

Variable name Description Units Settable
PLANE ALTITUDE The altitude of the aircraft above mean sea level. feet, meters Yes
AIRSPEED INDICATED The indicated airspeed of the aircraft. knots, feet per second, meters per second No
ENGINE RPM:index The RPM of the indexed engine. rpm No
PLANE HEADING DEGREES MAGNETIC Deprecated: Use PLANE HEADING DEGREES TRUE The heading of the aircraft in degrees from magnetic north. degrees, radians Yes
GROUND ALTITUDE The altitude of the terrain beneath the aircraft. meters No

Additional Notes

All altitude values are referenced against WGS84 unless otherwise stated.
